issues.desc: PD-1 决策产物的可发现性/持久性风险：CHK-002 context 要求把决策 artifact 写在 .koala/story/actives/B-4bd4/evidence/（story-scoped、DONE 后会随 story 归档移动），但本 story 的全部用户价值正是「冻结一个供未来跨仓库 story 长期引用的权威合同」。决策若埋在临时 story 目录，后续 agent/用户在 story 关闭后将难以找到，用户最终会问「然后那个决策在哪、还算数吗」，用户价值落空。CHK-002 自己的 relatedDocs 已指向 docs/requirements/decisions/（role-separation.md / truth-source.md / story-lifecycle.md），说明权威决策的 canonical 家就在那里。建议：把 PD-1 决策写入或软链接到 docs/requirements/decisions/ 下的真相源文档，story evidence 只放推导过程。这是 advisory，不阻塞 INIT。

Background introduces PD-1 / FU-1/FU-2/FU-3 / L2 signing / trustLevel without inline definitions; a fresh reader must chase the CHK-001 source docs to understand the core terms. Standalone readability is recoverable (CHK-001 points to the B-0f04 evidence) but a one-line glossary in background would help.

CHK-002 places the PD-1 decision artifact "under the B story evidence directory", but this is a first-class product decision freezing the CLI role for the whole roadmap. Clarify in PLAN whether it should instead live in docs/requirements/decisions/ as a canonical truth source vs story-local evidence.

CHK-003 references "Milestone 2-6" which are not enumerated anywhere in background (only Milestone 1 and FU-1/2/3 appear). The mapping is inferable from index.json description (handshake/envelope/signing/heartbeat/receipt) but background should name the milestone set it routes to.
